in_marathi.name: Swarnimika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Swarnimika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Swarnimika is a beautiful and divine name derived from Sanskrit. It is composed of two words - Swarni and Mika, where Swarni means golden and Mika means lotus. Swarnimika is considered a symbol of purity, beauty, and strength. In Hindu mythology, the lotus is a sacred flower that blooms even in muddy waters, representing the divine ability to rise above adversity and remain pure.
